name: Carentan
text: Carentan (French pronunciation: [kaʁɑ̃tɑ̃]) is a small rural town near the north-eastern base of the French Cotentin Peninsula in Normandy in north-western France, with a population of about 6,000. It is a former commune in the Manche department. On 1 January 2016, it was merged into the new commune of Carentan-les-Marais.

depictions.name: Carentan
depictions.text: wwii Carentan is a multiplayer map featured in Call of Duty, Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty 2 and Call of Duty: WWII. It can also be seen in the map Infection in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. A winter-themed version of Carentan was also released for Call of Duty: WWII for the Winter Siege event, Winter Carentan.

depictions.name: Carentan
depictions.text: Carentan is a map featured in Hell Let Loose. Set during the Battle of Carentan fought between June 10th to June 14th 1944, the map depicts the engagement in World War II between airborne forces of the United States and Germany. This is the most urban map the game provides.
